title: CARET: Clinical Assertion-Aware Residual Calibration for Medical Image-Text Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.18811v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical vision--language models align radiographs with free-text reports, but radiology language distinguishes explicit findings, negation, uncertainty, and omission. Treating these report states as interchangeable during feature adaptation can change image predictions without supporting visual evidence. We introduce CARET, a parameter-efficient image-side adaptation method that retains pretrained image and text encoders and uses paired positive and negative clinical statements to define a low-dimensional semantic correction space. A bounded residual adjusts image features along these directions, while assertion-aware supervision distinguishes explicitly present and absent findings from uncertain or unmentioned ones. At inference, the adapter requires only an image; textual references remain fixed. In zero-shot classification, CARET achieves 67.80\% accuracy on CheXpert 5$\times$200 and 65.20\% on RSNA. translated_title: CARET：面向医学图像-文本对齐的临床断言感知残差校准
translated_abstract: 医学视觉-语言模型将放射影像与自由文本报告进行对齐，但放射学语言会区分明确的发现、否定、不确定性以及遗漏。在特征适配过程中将这些报告状态视为可互换的，可能会在没有相应视觉证据支持的情况下改变图像预测。我们提出了CARET，这是一种参数高效的图像侧适配方法，它保留预训练的图像和文本编码器，并使用成对的正向和负向临床陈述来定义一个低维语义校正空间。有界的残差沿着这些方向调整图像特征，同时断言感知监督将明确存在和明确缺失的发现与不确定或未提及的发现区分开来。在推理时，该适配器仅需输入图像，文本引用保持固定。在零样本分类中，CARET在CheXpert 5×200上达到67.80%的准确率，在RSNA上达到65.20%。这些分数超过了已发表的基线。
tldr: CARET是一种参数高效的医学图像侧适配方法，通过利用成对的正负临床陈述构建低维语义校正空间并进行断言感知监督，有效区分放射报告中明确存在、缺失、不确定和未提及的发现，在零样本分类任务上超越了已发表的基线。
en_tdlr: CARET is a parameter-efficient image-side adaptation method that defines a low-dimensional semantic correction space using paired positive and negative clinical statements with assertion-aware supervision, effectively distinguishing explicitly present, absent, uncertain, and unmentioned findings in radiology reports, exceeding published baselines on zero-shot classification.
